question: Where should BirdClaw expose explicit OAuth2 account selection without changing the established local-only behavior of plain initialization?
rationale: The PR adds a new CLI option and provider-selection behavior, while current documentation and the merged hydration implementation establish an explicit live-read boundary; choosing the permanent CLI contract requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Use the hydration command
options.body: Add `--account <username>` to the explicit profile-hydration workflow and leave every form of plain initialization local-only.

options.title: Require init opt-in
options.body: Retain account selection on initialization only when an explicit flag is supplied, while plain `birdclaw init` performs no authenticated lookup.

options.title: Make lookup automatic
options.body: Approve authenticated selection during every initialization and document the resulting provider, availability, and API-call requirements.

recommendation.title: Use the hydration command
recommendation.body: Add `--account <username>` to the explicit profile-hydration workflow and leave every form of plain initialization local-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision owner for the permanent CLI and authentication-boundary contract.
